gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Editorial in attitude, Quilon swells faintly in every curve, while Noto Sans Wancho sets down hulking, chalky lowercase beneath it. Long paragraphs land dense and sturdy, each e gaping wide.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words as solid blocks, never skylines, beneath Quilon's softly modulated display strokes. Noto Sans Warang Citi's wide channels into each counter keep longer text flowing smoothly.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-yi: Modern from the start, Noto Sans Yi puts a deep midsection and open, unlatched rounds beneath Quilon's restrained display strokes. Longer text feels sturdy and unhurried, with plenty of body in each line.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Approachable from the first line, Quilon carries a slight pressure shadow like worn charcoal. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square has wide gaps and a soaring x-height, so it stays crisp at tiny sizes.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like a broad-nibbed pen that never curls shut. Quilon's editorial, commanding display strokes give that approachable body a firm lead, while the body's bowls fill every line.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-numans: Modern and clean, Quilon swells and thins gently up top, while an s with ends hung far from its spine sits below. Numans, with tightly coiled lowercase and generous tracking, lets the heading do the talking.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-onest: Quilon sets an editorial tone with low-to-medium contrast across its display strokes. And Onest, with short ascenders above big bowls and one fixed nib width, reads smoothly down a full column.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-open-sans: Open Sans lays down a smooth, unclogged read with bulky lowercase proportions, sitting under Quilon's in-between stroke contrast. Next to each other, one is editorial and the other plainly sturdy.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-orienta: Modern in feel, Orienta lets its counters breathe like a hollow reed, with little height difference between cases. But Quilon's weight changes, present yet never dramatic, would lose their pull in a small heading.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-oxygen: Editorial swagger up top, open curves just below. Quilon's soft thick-thin difference leads clearly, while Oxygen's curves never close back on themselves and its lowercase nearly matches the capitals.
